sources.title: jev-27b: open AI decision model by AutoTrust AI Lab
sources.snippet: JEV-27B AutoTrust's student of TypeSafe Jev 1.13. A frozen Qwen3.8-27B plus a 108.9M-parameter decision block trained on Jev's own output distributions; one set of weights answers typed questions in one pass (System 1) or generates text with the untouched base (System 2).
